summary: Iteration 29: price/stock change history (Riwayat Harga & Stok) and import recognition of 'URL Foto' / 'Maks. Beli'. Backend: 13/13 new pytest tests passed, plus the iter27/28 regression suites (38/38 total, run with -n0 because the shared module state does not work under xdist). Access checks: unauthenticated -> 401, customer demo -> 403, jombang with store_id=pgs-official -> 403, acct1 sees only its own store and gets 403 for other stores, admin sees everything and can filter by store. Logs are written with the correct before/after values, user_name and source for: editor edits (price 15000->18000, stock 10->7; creating a product writes no log; republishing unchanged writes no log), bulk edit (simple product plus variant rows labeled Merah/Biru; repeating the same bulk writes no log), import commit=true (Produk row plus Variasi sheet row with the variant label; commit=false writes no log), PUT /seller/inventory by jombang on shared pgs-9957 (store_id=pgs-jombang, same value writes no log, restored to 0), and admin tiers (text '12+ Rp9.000', store pgs-official, restored). kind/q/product_id filters, skip/limit pagination, sort by newest first, and limit>100 -> 422 all work. A CSV with headers 'URL Foto' and 'Maks. Beli' maps them to images/max_order, missing=[], create=1. Frontend at 390x844, all working: as admin the cards show product, date, user, source, store and before->after with green/red colouring, and the store pills (6), Harga/Stok filters, search, tapping a product name (sets ?product=, shows the chip and hides search) and clearing the chip all work. The sidebar item nav-riwayat-harga-&-stok navigates correctly. pe-history in the editor of an existing product (44px high) opens the history filtered to that product and is not shown on /new. Jombang sees no store pills and only its own branch logs, and the empty state works. A customer deep link shows the 403 text. One bug found: saving unchanged tiers on a product without tier_prices writes a bogus log. Deprecated packages detected: none.

minor.issue: Saving unchanged (empty) tiers writes a bogus log 'Harga grosir manual (kosong) -> (kosong)'. 6615 of 6618 products have no tier_prices field, so old={} is compared with clean={langsung:[],pengecer:[],reseller:[]} and they look different. The same happens when old is missing some keys, e.g. 'langsung: 5+ Rp100' -> 'langsung: 5+ Rp100'. Reproduced via the API on a fresh TEST_ product. Fix: normalise old to {t: (old.get('tier_prices') or {}).get(t, []) for t in CUSTOMER_TYPES} in server.py:1231, or in history.diff compare tiers_text(before) != tiers_text(after).

Edge case: when variants are turned off (before has variants, after has none) or a variant is removed, nothing is logged. The 'not (bv or av)' check skips the simple price/stock fields and the loop only goes over the after-variants. The product's new price/stock is lost from the history.
Cosmetic: tier text uses the internal keys 'langsung/pengecer/reseller' in lowercase. Use the display labels (Langsung/Pengecer/Reseller).

issues: For a product without a discount, one edit shows two identical rows ('Harga normal Rp20.000 -> Rp26.000' and 'Harga jual Rp20.000 -> Rp26.000'). Consider merging them when original_price == price on both sides.
The tappable product name (Pressable in LogCard) has no testID and no visual cue that it can be tapped (no colour or chevron). Add testID e.g. ph-product-{log_id} and link styling.
When the product filter is active the search box is hidden, but any q typed earlier is still sent with the request. This is harmless today but confusing. Consider clearing q when product is set.
A customer opening the deep link sees the 403 error and 'Belum ada perubahan...' at the same time. Hide the empty text when err is set.
Web only: the focused search TextInput shows a black rectangular focus outline inside the rounded pill (add outlineStyle:'none' on web).

action_items: Fix the bogus tier history log: normalise old tier_prices to all CUSTOMER_TYPES keys before history.record (server.py ~1231), or compare the tiers_text values in history.diff.
Optional: log changes when variants are removed or turned off (history.diff edge case).
Optional UI polish: merge the duplicate Harga normal/Harga jual rows, add a testID and link styling to the product name, hide the empty text when there is an error.
critical_code_review_comments: history.py is clean: _id is excluded, limit is capped at 100, regex is escaped, store scope is enforced server-side for non-admins.
admin_set_tiers computes old before the update and only checks for 404 after update_one. This is safe today because of the matched_count check, but find_one + 404 first would be clearer.
Iter27/28 tests left orphan price_history logs for their TEST_ products. Their teardowns now also delete those logs.

success_rate.backend: 100% (38/38; 1 minor bug found outside the asserted paths)

seed_data_creation: None left behind. TEST_Hist/TEST_UI29 products and their logs were deleted. Jombang stock for pgs-9957 was restored to 0 and tiers to the original value. price_history count is 0 and the catalogue is at 6618.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend tests with -n0 (pytest.ini enables xdist and the module-level TAG/PRODUCTS state breaks across workers). Export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. For UI, set localStorage 'pgs_auth_token'. ui_iter29_helper.py create/clean seeds history logs.
